summary:
Comprehensive implementation plan for the 8 ERP/POS enhancements in Al-Mohaseb (Flutter/SQLite/Firebase):
1. Icon Picker instant selection and auto-close.
2. Compact Color Picker with sleek horizontal/compact circles.
3. POS Item Card layout refactoring to prevent (+) button overlap with item name.
4. POS Sections collapsed by default on entry with an expandable toggle.
5. One-tap Hold / New Bill button in the POS header alongside Held Bills.
6. Media & Sync for Organization Logo across group members and ultra-compressed Item Thumbnails synced via cloud operations and snapshots.
7. Compact POS Header & Immersive scroll mode to maximize item grid viewport.
8. Full support for General Section ('عام') and NULL section/category items in POS and Inventory.
